events.name: Monster Jam
events.info: Get ready for the ultimate family day out! With awesome trucks, amazing stunts and action-packed excitement, Monster Jam® is the definition of fun for everyone! You'll be close to the action watching the world's best drivers tear up the dirt and show off crazy skills and all-out racing in fierce head-to-head battles of speed and skill. See the world's most popular trucks like Grave Digger®, El Toro Loco®, Sparkle Smash® and more only at Monster Jam. Be loud, cheer hard and watch these Monster Jam trucks do the impossible. It's too fun to miss!
events.pleaseNote: -All guests age 2 & older are required to have a ticket. -No costumes for guests 14 & older. -Please monitor the venue website for venue policies, including health and safety protocols, which are subject to change. -All tickets are subject to availability. -Prices & Competitors are subject to change. -Monster Jam Trackside begins approximately one hour before the event start time and features: o Competition Preview o Driver Interviews o Behind the Scenes with the Pit Crew o Judges Zone Overview o Opening Ceremonies o Giveaways o Power Rush Truck Introductions There's no better way to get ready for the action, so get to your seats early to experience all the family fun. -Visit MonsterJam.com for more event info and Ticket Terms and Conditions.

events.name: Worcester Railers vs. Maine Mariners - Monkey Wrenches Weekend (Fri)
events.info: For one weekend only, the Worcester Railers will become the Worcester Monkey Wrenches, an alternate identity celebrating the creativity, innovation, and hardworking spirit that has helped define Worcester for generations! The Railers will take the ice wearing specialty Worcester Monkey Wrenches jerseys, bringing the team's alternate identity to life and paying tribute to the city's proud manufacturing roots and reputation as a hub of innovation. Exclusive Worcester Monkey Wrenches merchandise will be available throughout the arena, giving fans the opportunity to take home limited-edition apparel and collectibles available only during the event. Fans can also visit a special Museum of Worcester display on the concourse, showcasing the people, inventions, businesses, and innovations that helped shape Worcester into the city it is today. The exhibit will highlight Worcester's unique legacy of ingenuity and industrial achievement while connecting fans to the community's rich history.

events.name: Worcester Railers vs. Trenton Ironhawks - Military Appreciation Night
events.info: The Railers will take the ice in specialty Military Appreciation jerseys, paying tribute to the courage and commitment of our nation's armed forces. Following the game, the jerseys will be auctioned off, with proceeds benefiting a military-focused charitable organization. Additional auction details will be announced closer to game day. Fans can also shop exclusive Military Appreciation merchandise available only during the event. From limited-edition apparel to commemorative items, these special pieces are a great way to show your support while celebrating one of the season's most meaningful nights. As a thank you for their service, veterans will receive complimentary tickets to the game. More information on how to claim free tickets, including eligibility and availability, will be released closer to the event.

events.name: Worcester Railers vs. Adirondack Thunder - Bravehearts Night
events.info: The Worcester Railers HC are ready to hit the ice for their ninth season in the ECHL ? the premier AA hockey league and proud developmental partner of the NHL and AHL. Since arriving in Worcester in 2016, the Railers have built a reputation for hard-hitting hockey, unforgettable theme nights, and affordable family fun at the DCU Center. Fans can look forward to another exciting season packed with rivalries, specialty jerseys, giveaways, family entertainment, and the loudest atmosphere in Worcester hockey.
events.pleaseNote: Ages 2+ need a ticket. Bags larger than 8"X10" will not be permitted into the venue. No outside food or drinks allowed.

events.name: Damascus Road Tour with Josiah Queen
events.info: Fresh off the release of his new album, Damascus Road, Josiah Queen is bringing his most anticipated tour yet to 17 cities across the U.S. and Canada this spring. Featuring brand-new music alongside the songs that have made him one of Christian music's fastest-rising artists, this tour promises an unforgettable evening filled with passionate worship, honest moments, and powerful ministry. Whether you've followed Josiah from the beginning or are discovering his music for the first time, the Damascus Road tour is an invitation to gather, worship, and celebrate together. Don't miss your chance to experience these songs live this spring. Visit tprlive.co for tickets and more information.
